GitHub is the best place to share code with friends, co-workers, classmates, and complete strangers.
Originally founded by Tom Preston-Werner , Chris Wanstrath , and PJ Hyett to simplify sharing code, GitHub has grown into the world's largest code host.
With the collaborative features of GitHub.com , our desktop apps , and GitHub Enterprise , it has never been easier for individuals and teams to write better code, faster.

Whether using GitHub.com or your own instance of GitHub Enterprise , you can integrate GitHub with third party tools , from project management to continuous deployment, to build software in the way that works best for you.
GitHub is how people build software.
GitHub is the best place to share code with friends, co-workers, classmates, and complete strangers.
Over eight million people use GitHub to build amazing things together.
With a community of more than 10 million people, developers can discover, use, and contribute to over 25 million projects using a powerful collaborative development workflow .
